content.text:
Fixed. All 5 tests pass.

**Bug:** `Inventory.low_stock` in `inventory/core.py` used `item.quantity < threshold`, so items exactly at the threshold were excluded. The docstring and `test_low_stock_includes_threshold` both say "at or below," so I changed the comparison to `<=`.

I also installed pytest, which wasn't present in the environment.
